==About==

With the [[Vegetable Potting]] Skill learned, a Onion can be grown by planting another {{i|Onion}} in a {{i|Gardening Pot}}. Planting Vegetables in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]]. A Onion can be stored in a {{i|Veggie Sack}}.
